candidates.change_summary: Change the declared return type of decimals() from uint8 to uint256 so that callers observing decimals() receive a uint256 value (different from original uint8).
Change the totalSupply() interface function to return a different uint256 value (e.g., zero) by adding a concrete implementation that returns 0 instead of declaring it as abstract.
candidates.mutated_unit_code: function totalSupply() external view returns (uint256) { return 0; }

candidates.change_summary: Replace the line that increments mapSynth_LPDebt[msg.sender] to instead decrement it, changing how debt is recorded and thus affecting subsequent mapSynth_LPBalance calculations after mintSynth.
Replace the line that increases mapSynth_LPBalance[msg.sender] with a decrement, so LP balance bookkeeping is updated in the opposite direction when minting synthetic tokens.
Insert an extra increment of mapSynth_LPBalance[msg.sender], doubling the LP balance increase on mintSynth and thus changing observed mapSynth_LPBalance values.
Delete the statement that updates mapSynth_LPBalance[msg.sender], so mintSynth no longer records added LP units and observable mapSynth_LPBalance can differ.

Change onlyPool modifier behavior to require msg.sender equals DEPLOYER instead of checking isCuratedPool, altering which callers can invoke mintSynth and thus which keys' mapSynth_LPBalance can be affected.
